description: This file defines a Java class `UnassignClientStaffCommandHandler` which handles the command for unassigning staff from a client within the Fineract financial software. It is annotated as a Spring service and implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface, delegating the unassignment logic to `ClientWritePlatformService`.

classes.name: UnassignClientStaffCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed service class that handles the unassignment of staff from a client, based on command processing.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to unassign staff from a client, invoking the service layer.
